collection.description: A child notices dough swelling before it is cooked.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) notices dough swelling before it is cooked.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (cook), a cook, explains that yeast produces gas that makes bubbles.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The dough becomes sticky, and (cook) teaches patience.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (cook) jokes that the dough is stretching awake, then explains the real cause.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (child) names the dough before it goes into the oven.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (child) learns that not every bread rises the same way.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: A batch stays flat, prompting a new question.
